Congress seeks Defence Minister's resignation over Operation Sindoor remarks

The Congress party is demanding the resignation of Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and seeking privilege proceedings against him. This follows remarks made by Singh in Parliament regarding Operation Sindoor, which the opposition claims misled the House and insulted soldiers. The government has denied these claims, stating they are factually incorrect.
